Method of Attack: Remote code execution by executing arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system within the same physical or logical network
Discoverer: Antonin B. of NATO Cyber Security Centre
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated threat actor within the same physical or logical network

Method of Attack: Authenticated remote attacker performing arbitrary file writes to sensitive directories, leading to command execution in the context of a web application's user
Impacted Systems: On-premises versions of Neurons for ITSM
Attack Vector: Authenticated remote user performing file writes

Method of Attack: Mutation cross-site scripting (mXSS) to bypass sandbox and Content Security Policy (CSP) protections, achieving code execution when a user replies to or forwards a malicious email
Impacted Systems: Mailspring aka Nylas Mail (open-source email client)
Attack Vector: Malicious email payload that mutates during re-parsing
